    • getMaximumFunctionChainLength

      public int getMaximumFunctionChainLength()
      Description copied from interface: ThreadMetaData

      Obtains the maximum FunctionState chain length for this ThreadState.

      Once the FunctionState chain has reached this length, it will be broken. (spawned in another Thread). This avoids StackOverflowError issues in FunctionState chain being too large.

      Specified by:
      getMaximumFunctionChainLength in interface ThreadMetaData
      Returns:
      Maximum FunctionState chain length for this ThreadState.
